subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If an authored e2e test's verdict varies across runs on identical input, or depends on wall-clock, network, load, ordering, or ambient repository state, then the system shall stop that task before consuming further self-heal iterations, mark it failed naming the non-hermetic dependency, preserve its work, escalate, and never count it succeeded or wire it into required checks
intent: task in the failed class with the non-hermetic dependency named
fit_criterion: seeded flaky and environment-dependent fixtures stop with the dependency named, consume no self-heal iterations beyond detection, and are never counted succeeded; a hermetic test in the same run is unaffected
